expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.groupsHint: This event’s own cost groups. Changes to the templates (Finance → Cost groups) do not affect them.
expenses.templatesAdded: {count, plural, =0 {No new templates – all active templates are already included.} one {# cost group added from templates} other {# cost groups added from templates}}
expenses.publishHint: The cost group then becomes available under Organisation → Cost groups as a template for new events. The group in this event stays unchanged.
expenses.deactivateHint: Existing expenses keep the group. It can no longer be chosen for new expenses. You can activate it again at any time.
expenses.name: Name
expenses.speakerLinkHint: Expenses in this group can be assigned to a speaker of the event.
expenses.noActiveGroups: No active cost group – please add or activate one first.
expenses.amountHint: Gross amount. The organiser is not VAT-registered (see Organiser and VAT settings).
expenses.speaker: Speaker (optional)
expenses.noSpeakers: No speakers have been added to this event yet.
expenses.receiptHint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, max. 10 MB.
expenses.receiptReplaceHint: A new file replaces the current receipt.
expenses.deleteHint: The expense and its receipt will be removed permanently.

costGroups.title: Cost groups
costGroups.hint: Templates for new events. Each new event gets its own copy of the active templates – changes here do not affect existing events. Edit an event’s cost groups under Event → Expenses, where you can also add new templates.
costGroups.eventCount: {count, plural, =0 {no event} one {# event} other {# events}}
costGroups.deactivateHint: New events will no longer receive this template. Existing events keep their cost group.

pnl.title: Profit and loss
pnl.openTickets: {count, plural, one {# registration not yet paid} other {# registrations not yet paid}}
pnl.more: {count, plural, one {# more item} other {# more items}} in the table
pnl.noTrend: No payments yet, so there is no trend to show.
pnl.trendAria: Line chart: cumulative result per week

reg.title: Registrations
reg.total: {count, plural, =0 {No registrations yet} one {# registration} other {# registrations}}
reg.same: the same as {name} at this point
reg.none: The trend appears here as soon as registrations come in.
reg.weekNote: New registrations per calendar week, aligned by distance to the event.
reg.monthNote: New registrations per month, aligned by distance to the event.
reg.aria: Line chart: new registrations over time

pnl.noPlan: No plan has been entered for this variant yet.
pnl.noCandidates: There is no other event to compare with yet.
pnl.legend: Actual = money that has actually moved. Open = not yet paid. Forecast = actual + open. Deviation = forecast − plan. All amounts in euros, gross.

planDialog.title: Enter plan
planDialog.intro: Expected tickets, sponsor income and a budget per cost group. Each variant is saved separately.
planDialog.priceHint: Without a price, the event's ticket price applies. Free tickets only count as a number.
planDialog.noGroups: This event has no cost groups yet. They are created under “Expenses”.

certificate.title: Certificate of attendance
certificate.intro: Template for the certificate of attendance as a PDF (A4 landscape). Date, time, location and event name come from the event settings. It is issued from the attendee list: tick the people and choose “Certificate”.
certificate.imageHint: PNG or JPG, max. 5 MB, ideally A4 landscape (e.g. 3508 × 2480 pixels). The image fills the whole page; logos and signatures can be part of it. A new image replaces the previous one.
certificate.heading: Heading
certificate.placeholders: Placeholders: '{name}' (person’s name), '{event}' (event name), '{datum}' (event date), '{uhrzeit}' (start–end, e.g. 08:00–18:00), '{ort}' (location). A line that contains only '{name}' is set large and bold, a line with only '{event}' in bold.
certificate.textColorHint: To match the background, e.g. #1a1a1a or #ffffff.
certificate.previewUnsaved: The preview shows the saved version – please save first.
certificate.usage: The preview uses a sample name.

gdpr.title: Data protection (GDPR)
gdpr.intro: Access, restriction and erasure for data subjects, requests with deadlines and the automatic retention periods.

search.title: Find person
search.hint: By e-mail address (case-insensitive), name or company. Finds attendees, speakers and sponsor contacts.
search.name: Name
search.none: No person found. You can still record the request below without a person.

person.actionsHint: The export contains all stored data (Art. 15/20 GDPR) and is logged. Restricting blocks e-mails, portal and exports. Erasing anonymises the person; invoices are kept until the end of the retention period (§ 132 BAO).
person.restrictText: The person no longer receives e-mails, cannot use the portal and no longer appears in exports and certificates. Open restriction requests are marked as completed.
person.eraseText: Name, e-mail, company, phone, consents, sponsor assignments, portal account, billing details and member numbers of registrations are deleted. Registrations and payments remain without a name for statistics. This cannot be undone.
person.eraseRetained: {count, plural, one {# invoice is} other {# invoices are}} kept with the recipient until the end of the retention period (§ 132 BAO).
person.blockedActive: Erasure is possible once {count, plural, one {the active registration is} other {the # active registrations are}} cancelled or the event is over.
person.blockedRefunds: Erasure is possible once {count, plural, one {the open refund is} other {the # open refunds are}} settled.
person.retained: {count, plural, one {# invoice is} other {# invoices are}} subject to the retention obligation (7 years from year end, § 132 BAO).
person.storedHint: Overview; the export contains all details.

requests.title: Data subject requests
requests.hint: Record every request (access, rectification, erasure …) with its date of receipt. Deadline: one month from receipt (Art. 12 GDPR). Erasing and restricting complete open requests of the same type automatically.
requests.newWithoutPerson: Record a request without a person
requests.newHint: For example if no data is stored for the address. For a person you found, record the request on their page.

retention.title: Retention periods
retention.hint: The retention run happens once a day with the scheduled jobs (or via “npm run retention”) and is logged.
retention.ruleUnpaid: Cancelled and waitlisted registrations without payment: deleted {days} days after the event.
retention.rulePeople: Other personal data: anonymised {months} months after the last event the person attended.
retention.ruleBusiness: Speakers and sponsor contacts (business contacts): only {years} years after their last event in that role.
retention.ruleOrphans: People without registration, speaker role or sponsor assignment: deleted after {days} days.
retention.ruleInvoices: Invoices and credit notes: 7 years from the end of the year of issue (§ 132 BAO), then recipient cleared and PDF deleted.
retention.ruleAudit: Audit log: entries deleted after {years} years.
retention.runText: All due data will be deleted or anonymised now. This cannot be undone.

items.deletedRegistrations: delete {count, plural, one {# registration} other {# registrations}}
items.anonymizedPeople: anonymise {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
items.keptAsBusinessContact: keep {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} as speaker/sponsor contact for now
items.deletedPeople: delete {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} without involvement
items.purgedInvoices: clear the recipient of {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}
items.deletedAuditEntries: delete {count, plural, one {# audit entry} other {# audit entries}}
items.deletedVerifications: delete {count, plural, one {# expired link} other {# expired links}}
items.deletedBackups: delete {count, plural, one {# backup} other {# backups}}

pricing.title: Prices & discounts
pricing.earlyBirdHint: Period and early bird prices are set in the event settings next to the prices.
pricing.codesHint: For flash sales and mailings: attendees enter the code when registering. It applies to the regular and member price only, not to early bird.
pricing.codeRule: Deducted from the regular or member price, never below €0. If the early bird price is lower, it applies and the code is not redeemed. Cancelled registrations release the redemption.
pricing.categoriesHint: Custom price categories for this event (e.g. students, volunteers). Selectable when adding or editing a registration in the admin area, not public.
pricing.deleteCategoryText: The special price “{name}” will be deleted. If it is already in use, please deactivate it instead.
pricing.deleteCodeText: The discount code {name} will be deleted. If it has already been redeemed, please deactivate it instead.

eventPage.title: Event page
eventPage.headerIntro: Tagline, header image and logo appear large at the top of the public event page.
eventPage.heroNone: No header image – the page shows a colour area.
eventPage.heroHint: Wide image (e.g. 1920 × 600), PNG, JPG or WebP, max. 5 MB. Light text is placed on top.
eventPage.highlightsIntro: Up to three short points with title and text. Points without a title are left out.
eventPage.galleryIntro: Pictures for "Impressions", e.g. from last year. At most {max} pictures.
eventPage.galleryFullHint: The gallery holds at most {max} pictures.
eventPage.deleteImageHint: "{name}" will be removed from the gallery.
eventPage.imageHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, max. 5 MB.
eventPage.logoHint: Shown top left in the header on a dark background – ideally a light version with a transparent background (PNG).
eventPage.colorsIntro: Colours of the public event page, e.g. from the corporate design. Empty = EventFlow default.
eventPage.color_primary_hint: Tint over the header image, times in the programme, sponsor area, highlighted price.
eventPage.color_dark_hint: Introduction below the header and closing call to action.
eventPage.highlightIconHint: Square image, shown round. PNG, JPG or WebP, max. 5 MB.
